Roughly a quarter of the prose reads machine-written, concentrated in the closing paragraphs of 6.1.2, 6.3, 6.4.3, 6.5 and 6.6 (semicolon chains, 'not only ... but also', 'Importantly', 50-60-word sentences) and in the patched implementation caveats that were inserted into the step lists; the numbered steps themselves are largely in the author's voice.
